methodologyNotes: Roster covers 12 widely-searched home-theater AV receivers released 2020–2023 spanning entry, mid, upper-mid, and premium tiers from Denon, Marantz, Yamaha, Sony, Onkyo, and Anthem. Specs were independently re-verified against manufacturer product pages and spec manuals (denon.com, marantz.com, manuals.marantz.com, usa.yamaha.com, manual.yamaha.com, anthemav.com, onkyo.com) cross-checked with major retailers (Best Buy, Sweetwater, B&H) and specialist coverage (Audioholics, Crutchfield, What Hi-Fi, AVForums). Watts per channel are rated at 8 ohm 20 Hz–20 kHz 2-channel driven unless otherwise noted; hdmi_inputs_8k counts only HDMI ports capable of 8K/60Hz or 4K/120Hz; dolby_atmos is true/false; priceUsd is US MSRP (current list, or documented launch price where noted). Adversarial pass corrected 3 fields: Denon X4800H release year (2022→2023), Marantz Cinema 70s price ($1,199→$1,300), Onkyo TX-NR6100 release year (2022→2021). Sony STR-AN1000 watts_per_channel_8ohm intentionally null (rated at 6 ohm). accessedAt 2026-06-19.

products.name: Denon AVR-X4800H

specs.wireless_streaming: HEOS, Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, AirPlay 2, Spotify Connect

products.provenance: Price ($2,799), 125W/ch, 9.4ch, 7 HDMI inputs all 8K-ready, Audyssey MultEQ XT32 with Dirac upgrade all re-confirmed on Denon US product page. Release year corrected 2022->2023: AVR-X4800H is the 2023 US flagship (announced Sep 2022 in EU, US availability Jan 2023; The Source AV and retail listings tag it as 2023). The 2020 model was the X4700H.

products.name: Denon AVR-X3800H

specs.wireless_streaming: HEOS, Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, AirPlay 2, Spotify Connect

products.provenance: MSRP $1,799, 105W/ch, 9.4ch confirmed on Denon US page. All 6 HDMI inputs are 8K-capable on this upper-tier model (page states 'All 8k') — verified, draft's 6/6 correct. Audyssey MultEQ XT32 + Dirac upgrade confirmed. Released Oct 2022.

products.name: Denon AVR-X1800H

specs.wireless_streaming: HEOS, Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, AirPlay 2, Spotify Connect

products.provenance: MSRP $849, 80W/ch, 7.2ch, 6 HDMI inputs with 3 supporting 8K/HDMI 2.1, Audyssey MultEQ XT, HEOS all confirmed via Denon and retailer listings. Announced/launched 2023 (available early October 2023 per Alpha Audio).

products.name: Denon AVR-S970H

specs.wireless_streaming: HEOS, Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, AirPlay 2, Spotify Connect

products.provenance: MSRP $949 confirmed directly on Denon US product page (retail discount listings of $749 are not MSRP). 90W/ch at 8 ohm, 7.2ch, 6 HDMI inputs / 3 with 8K, Audyssey MultEQ (standard) all verified. 2022 model year.

products.name: Marantz Cinema 70s

products.name: Yamaha RX-V6A

specs.wireless_streaming: MusicCast, Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, AirPlay 2, Spotify Connect

products.provenance: Yamaha USA specs page confirms 100W/ch (8 ohm, 0.06% THD), 7.2ch, 7 HDMI inputs with only the first 3 (HDMI1-3) supporting 8K60/4K120 — draft's hdmi_inputs_8k=3 verified correct. Dolby Atmos, YPAO. Launch MSRP $599.95; available October 2020.

products.name: Yamaha RX-A4A

specs.wireless_streaming: MusicCast, Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, AirPlay 2, Spotify Connect

products.provenance: Yamaha USA specs and Crutchfield confirm 110W/ch (8 ohm), 7.2ch, 7 HDMI 2.1 inputs ALL supporting 8K60 and 4K120 (upper-tier AVENTAGE, unlike the V6A which limits 8K to 3 inputs) — draft's hdmi_inputs_8k=7 verified correct. YPAO R.S.C. 3D. MSRP $1,499.95, 2021.

products.name: Yamaha RX-V4A

specs.wireless_streaming: MusicCast, Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, AirPlay 2, Spotify Connect

products.provenance: Yamaha USA/manual confirm 80W (8 ohm USA spec), 5.2ch, 4 HDMI inputs / 1 with 8K. dolby_atmos=false VERIFIED correct: the RX-V4A is a 5.2 receiver with no height channels and Dolby Atmos is absent from the spec sheet (only Dolby TrueHD/Digital Plus listed). products.name: Sony STR-AN1000

specs.room_correction: D.C.A.C. IX (Digital Cinema Auto Calibration IX)
specs.wireless_streaming: Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, AirPlay 2, Spotify Connect, Google Chromecast, Works with Sonos

MSRP $900 confirmed (announced Feb 2023). watts_per_channel_8ohm intentionally null: Sony publishes power at 6 ohm (100W/6ohm 2ch), not 8 ohm — null beats a guess.

products.name: Onkyo TX-NR6100

specs.wireless_streaming: Chromecast built-in, AirPlay 2, DTS Play-Fi, Works with Sonos, Spotify Connect, Bluetooth

products.provenance: Onkyo product page confirms 100W/ch (8 ohm, 0.08% THD, 2ch), 7.2ch, 6 HDMI inputs with inputs 1-3 supporting 8K/60 & 4K/120 (4-6 are 4K/60), Dolby Atmos, AccuEQ with AccuReflex, THX Select, plus Chromecast/AirPlay 2/DTS Play-Fi/Works with Sonos. MSRP $799. Release year corrected 2022->2021 (launched late 2021; the 2022 date was the spec-sheet PDF revision).

products.name: Anthem MRX 740 8K

specs.wireless_streaming: AirPlay 2, Google Cast, Spotify Connect, Bluetooth

products.provenance: Anthem product page confirms 7 amplifier channels at 140W/8 ohm, 11.2 pre-amp channels, 7 HDMI 2.1 inputs all supporting 8K/60 or 4K/120, Dolby Atmos/DTS:X/IMAX Enhanced, ARC Genesis. MSRP $3,099.99 confirmed (Choice Audio, Upscale Audio). Base MRX 740 launched Feb 2021; the 8K-board variant followed in 2022 — 2022 retained for the 8K model as the draft specifies.
